1.0.1 Metadata

1.0.1.1 Description

Dataset name: Model predictions for the 4 models

Data frame describing the model predictions of the 4 models. This data frame is generated by the experiment1_preprocessing.Rmd script. This data frame has 210 rows, corresponding to the total number of item pairings of 15 items (225) and excluding self pairs. The columns are the different models, and their numerical row values represent similarity scores with 0 being very similar and 1 being very disimilar. These values will be used to build model RDMs for comparison with the empirical RDMs from the Causal Pairs Task and Sorting Task.

1.1.3 model1_mind_action_body

Similarity value assigned to each item pairing for the Mind, Body, Action model. For example, a similarity of 0 for hear something and see something indicated the model predicts these two items are very similar, since they are both predicted to be in the Mind category
